{if:SF.IsMythic}{c_mythic}{/if}Damaging a Close enemy with {c_important}Marksman{/c} or {c_important}Cutthroat{/c} Skills each grant a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"|%+|]{/c} Attack Speed bonus for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds.
